entries.en: proverb; adage
as the old saying goes; the proverb says
the proverb says; it is said in the adage

entries.zh: 削；用刀刮削使薄（如削果皮、bexuco 薯类）
entries.en: to peel or shave thin (fruit, tubers); to whittle
to arrange, put in order
entries.notes: 词头缩写展开（dar q.e componer）依赖推断；叠/收拾义与汉字相符。

entries.zh: 打叠；收拾任何东西、整理
entries.en: to tidy up, pack up (any thing)
to mend, repair
to refit, put in trim (a ship)
to overhaul, rebuild (a ship or house)
to cook, prepare food
to dress, season and cook (food)
to dress (a woman's) hair in a knot; chignon

entries.zh: （办得）双粿；把东西办得很好、备办齐整
entries.en: to prepare very well, set out nicely
entries.notes: 双粿字面为成对糕点，西语 'adereçar algo muy bien' 或指备办双份供品/糕点，语义存疑。

entries.en: to prepare the banquet, lay on food and wine
entries.notes: conbite（宴席）对应双粿酒，粿与酒并举；与上条同源，含义基本可定。

entries.en: to boil and dress (raw silk)

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕搯（掏/修葺房屋？）
entries.en: doubtful; possibly to patch or furnish (a house)
entries.notes: 汉字搯（掏）与 'adereçar como casa' 不甚相合，或有讹字，存疑。

entries.en: clever, quick-witted

entries.zh: 伶俐；干净利落、精明齐整
entries.en: neat and smart, clean and quick

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕嫩（西语栏空）
entries.en: doubtful; tender (young, fresh)?
entries.notes: 西语词头栏〔空〕，嫩字对音 nūn，无法与词头互证，存疑。

entries.en: ready, prepared, convenient
